cases.prompt: Use the agent-lexicon skill on this conversation context. We are defining a B2B SaaS billing domain for future agentic engineering work. A Workspace is the tenant that owns projects. A User is an authentication identity that can belong to many Workspaces. A Seat is a paid entitlement assigned to a User within one Workspace. People keep saying "account" to mean both Workspace and Billing Account. A Billing Account stores payment methods and receives invoices for one or more Workspaces. A Subscription belongs to a Billing Account and has one Pricing Plan. Create the AGENT_LEXICON.md file, update the existing AGENTS.md terminology pointer if needed, and summarize what you wrote.
